findings.claim: The xref bookish-AST ruling REPRODUCES on substance. Fresh 22.0.400 regen matched the headline to the integer: 5,481 /nodes/ pages, 0 errors, 72.1 MB; attrs.id coverage cop 99.4 / top 97.8 / lop 75.8 / sop 64.9 / vop 57.9 / dop 25.0 / chop 3.1 (all within 1% of claimed). sop/xform ids = t,r,s confirmed; APEX 618/594/598/0 exact.

CORRECTION: '6,281 JSON files on disk' does not reproduce. A clean regen writes 5,827 (5,481 /nodes/ pages + 346 include-target fragments). Minor, non-load-bearing, but exactly the unanchored-number class the crucible exists to catch.

SHARPENING: OneDrive cache 'only 6 top-level keys' is 8 (adds examplefile/examplefor); the 'no version stamp' core holds (0 version fields in 2,266 files). Zip-date inversion is 95.8% of common members, not total (212 .400 members newer, max 2026-08-01). Core 'cache unusable / build-blind' finding stands, mechanism intact (cachedt>=srcdt wikipages.py:200-209 + .400 members backdated to 2026-05-02).

SHARPENING: 'i1_extract reimplements 805 lines' is a ~2x over-attribution. ~400 lines are include+section machinery an AST replaces; the other ~400 (deprecation-union, floor ladder, EOL/BOM guards, contentfrom-follow, label-norm, 161/171 census) an AST does NOT provide.
findings.anchor: harness/notes/ingest/i1_extract.py (805 total; parse_text :397-594 + resolve_all :225-284 the reconstruction core)

findings.claim: DECISIVE QUALIFIER: the ID-join 'single largest correctness upgrade' is real but CONCENTRATED. attrs.id is dense only in cop/top/lop/sop; in chop(3%)/cop2(8%)/dop(25%)/out(35%)/obj(42%) LABEL and #channels must carry the join. attrs.id COVERAGE != join RESOLUTION: LABEL is present 100% and resolves ~89%, #id resolves ~43-53% today. LABEL/#channels fallback is mandatory on both branches.

The internal-API risk is REAL and HIGH. bookish/houdinihelp is undocumented, vendored (bookish=Whoosh author BSD), hou-coupled; no __all__/module-docstrings/stability markers. --disablehou dies at hstores.py:178 (AssetStore.list_all needs hou.nodeTypeCategories) -> no plain-CI regen, build-coupled. WikiPages.json signature already carries wcontext/process the ruling's assumed sig omits; AST section vocab (inputs_section/attrs.channels) is not a Python token at all -> silent breakage, undetectable by static check.

The multiparm-semantics question survives BOTH fork branches (confirmed against code). Menu-value vs multiparm-instance is indentation-only in the doc source; neither the i1_extract fold (:575-586) nor a doc-only parameters_item tree distinguishes them. Disambiguation needs a runtime parm-kind lookup no doc source supplies. Also the runtime probe stays mandatory either way (no source carries TYPE/DEFAULT/RANGE/menu).

for_ruling: Gate P fork is a genuine trade, not a clear winner: Branch A (i1_extract + 4 patches) = CI-portable, no license, calibrated 35/35 on COP/COP2/LOP, LABEL join (resolves ~89%). Branch B (bookish adapter) = free include/#contentfrom resolution, typed sections, ID join where dense, richer attrs -- at the cost of an undocumented hou-coupled internal API (HIGH fragility), no plain-CI regen, and a build-blind cache SYNAPSE must self-stamp.

Crucible advisory (human rules at Gate P): STAGED, not either/or. Ship Branch A's 4 patches now (cheap, localized, calibration-guarded, needed regardless). Adopt Branch B as an opt-in enrichment for cop/top/lop/sop only, gated behind (a) an AST-vocabulary schema-shape assertion, (b) a self-stamped build guard failing on cache.build != hou.applicationVersionString(), (c) a pinned minimal-symbol adapter. Do NOT delete the LABEL/#channels join or the nodes.zip/CI path.
Do not book Branch B as '805 lines saved' (~400) or 'join solved' (LABEL still resolves better; required in 6 contexts). Multiparm + runtime probe owed on both branches.
